title: Сделатьисправления
body:
1. Если нажать на кнопку меню с тремя вертикальными точками у карточки часового пояса (для обоих видов - карточки и сетка) в самой нижней части экрана, то открывающееся меню почти полностью уходит из видимости экрана. Надо исправить, чтобы пункты меню были всегда видны и доступны пользователю при нажатии кнопки с тремя точками на карточке часового пояса.
2. Когда выбираешь диапазон встречи, нажимаешь зелёную кнопку поделиться и в окне просмотра и настройки текста встречи снова нажимаешь кнопку поделиться акцентного цвета, выбираешь способ как именно поделиться, то после этого происходит переход обратно к сетке часовых поясов, а выбор диапазона времени встречи остаётся активным. Надо его сбрасывать. При этом, если пользователь выходит из окна просмотра и настойки текста встречи нажатием кнопки крестик, то выбор диапазона времени встречи должен оставаться активным, как это работает сейчас.
3. Обновить устаревшие скриншоты приложения в корневых README файлах на русском и английском языках.

report.details:
I'm failing this round on one finding. Almost everything else matches the change.

**The finding.** `useLocationMenuPlacement.ts:75` puts `overflowY: "auto"` on every open menu, including the ones that fit and get no height limit:

```ts
style: { ...fixedStyle, maxHeight: maxHeightPx, overflowY: "auto" },
```

The design (D2) says the scroll belongs only on a limited menu: "It sets `maxHeight` and `overflow-y: auto` on the menu element when `maxHeightPx` is defined." Non-goal NG2 says "The items, the look and the keyboard behaviour of the location menu do not change", and UX1 says a menu opened above "looks like one opened below".

In CSS, `overflow-y: auto` also turns `overflow-x` from `visible` into `auto`. Each menu item spans the full width of the menu and has a 2 px `focus-visible:outline`. So in every menu, not just the rare limited one, the left and right edges of the keyboard focus ring are now clipped. The test at `LocationMenu.placement.test.tsx:64` only checks that a limited menu has the scroll. No test checks that a menu that fits has none, so the tests can't catch this.

**What checks out:**
- **Placement rule:** `getLocationMenuPlacement` and `LocationMenuSide` follow D1. The hook reads the layout once per opening, scroll or resize and uses no `ResizeObserver`. `LocationMenu.tsx` is still 250 lines, and `useFixedMenuPosition` is gone.
- **Clearing after a share:** `useMeetingShare` calls `onMeetingShared` only for the shared outcome. In `AppShell.tsx`, Clear meeting and a shared outcome both use `clearMeetingAndFocusAddLocation`. The close button, Esc, copied, failed and cancelled all keep the range.
- **Tests and tags:** the new and changed unit tests, unit BDD and E2E feature files carry the change and requirement tags. The test for the date-bar layering scenario now uses the new scroll step, and no test uses `useFakeTimers` or `setSystemTime`.
- **README screenshots:** all ten baselines exist. The handoff patch points the English README at the five `-en` images and the Russian one at the five `-ru` images. None of its images point at `docs/design/screens`.
- **Docs:** the glossary entries and `docs/architecture/views.md` are updated.
- **Constant location:** the new margin constant sits in `constants/locationMenu.ts` rather than `grid.ts`, as task 2.2 asked. It's exported through `constants/index.ts`, and the file comment explains the move: it keeps the constant out of the initial bundle. I didn't count that as a violation.

**The fix:** add `overflowY: "auto"` only when `maxHeightPx` is defined, and add a test that a menu which fits has no `overflow-y`.

```json
{"passed": false, "findings": ["packages/client/src/views/shared/useLocationMenuPlacement.ts:75 sets `overflowY: \"auto\"` on every open menu (`style: { ...fixedStyle, maxHeight: maxHeightPx, overflowY: \"auto\" }`), not only on a limited one. design.md D2 says: \"It sets `maxHeight` and `overflow-y: auto` on the menu element when `maxHeightPx` is defined.\" Because `overflow-y: auto` also turns `overflow-x` into `auto`, every menu, even one that fits, now clips the left and right edges of its full-width items' 2px `focus-visible:outline`. That breaks NG2 (\"The items, the look and the keyboard behaviour of the location menu do not change\") and UX1. Add `overflowY: \"auto\"` only when `maxHeightPx !== undefined`, and add a test in LocationMenu.placement.test.tsx or useLocationMenuPlacement.test.ts that a menu which fits has no `overflow-y`. The current assertion at LocationMenu.placement.test.tsx:64 only covers the limited case, so it cannot catch this."]}
```
